label: Actual suppliers of actual concreta are concrete
definition: ActualSuppliersOfConcretaConcrete m w holds when every candidate existing at w that grounds an actual concretum at w in the selected relation is concrete. Ordinary meaning: within the selected direct relation, the being of actual concrete things is supplied only by concrete things. Example: a flame sustained by fuel. Counterexample (formal): Control.abstractSupplier, where an abstract item grounds every concretum. Distinguished from the stronger claim that concreta have no abstract explanation of any kind: grounds outside the selected relation are not constrained.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred (#310). It is the bridge under which the borrowed-reality principle yields closed-collection rootedness (closedRootedOfBorrowed). Rejected by views on which abstract items (forms, numbers, laws) sustain concreta; open premise.
